Summarize recorded fitting diagnostics

Source: R/diagnostics.R
diagnostics.Rd

Collect treatment-recoding information from atefit(), or recorded subgroup errors and warnings from count or survival catefit() and catecv(), into a data frame. Each row represents one recorded message. Survival subgroup messages also remain in object[["errors/warnings"]].

Usage

diagnostics(object)

Arguments

object

A binary, count or survival atefit, or a count or survival catefit or catecv result.

Value

A data frame with columns method, split, iteration, group, subgroup, type, measure, and message. For count mutually exclusive groups, subgroup gives the lower and upper boundaries; survival uses the upper percentile label recorded by the estimator. For atefit, bootstrap failures have split bootstrap, the replicate number in iteration, and the affected estimate in measure. Split and iteration are NA for catefit. Otherwise, measure is NA unless the recorded message identifies it. Returns a zero-row data frame with the same columns when there are no recorded messages.

Details

This reports only diagnostics stored in the result, not every warning emitted during fitting. In particular, atefit() stores the treatment-recoding information and failed or undefined bootstrap estimates, but not all bootstrap warnings. Count fits record subgroup messages and support in object$subgroup.support. Continuous results are not supported by this helper.

Author

Thomas Debray tdebray@fromdatatowisdom.com

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
diagnostics(output_atefit)
diagnostics(output_catecv)
subset(diagnostics(output_catecv), split == "validation")
} # }
